prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with knee injury after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 30 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1104; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Imaging and exam findings clearly confirm the injury.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with acute pain and swelling of the right knee. Mechanism of injury and force of impact are consistent with the reported knee complaints. Imaging and physical examination findings clearly confirm the injury, and no prior injury to the same body area is known from the patient history. Conservative management was provided over approximately 30 visits, including physical therapy, range-of-motion and strengthening exercises, and activity modification. Treatment duration was somewhat longer than typical for this type of injury, reflecting a gradual but steady response to care. Patient has shown functional improvement with ongoing residual stiffness on prolonged standing. Billing records reflect single entries for each service with no repeated charges. Continued home exercise program and follow-up as needed are recommended.
